log.msg: BROKEN #1 - the front door's headline gesture. The hover toolbar is drawn at y274-369 and the demo's own tab strip at y310-353, so all four tabs overlap it. Proven cold at 3440: elementFromPoint on each tab centre returns DIV.paging-toolbar for Overview, Pricing, Docs and Contact; a Playwright click on Pricing times out at 30s. At 1280 on /stage/ the tabs hit SPAN.paging-pick-label and SELECT. The Stage page's own opening line says 'Click the tabs on the page below and watch its white box' - with a mouse you cannot.

BROKEN #2 - the hub contradicts itself. Force-clicking the Pricing tab (the only way past #1) puts the caption THE BOX DID NOT MOVE - ONLY THIS DID inside the box, and the measurement line directly beneath it reads 'the page itself -> Pricing  The box is 335px shorter - same width'. The realm's first demo of its first block claims stability and disproves it in the same screen.

BROKEN #3 - literal markdown on 4 of the 6 block pages. The opening blockquote on /skin/ renders 'the toolbar has **two rows of colour**' with the asterisks visible; same on /content/ ('**content** dropdown'), /room/ ('**room** dropdown') and /arrangement/ ('**arrangement** dropdown'). Above the fold, on the pages that name the vocabulary.

BROKEN #4 - the takeover preset eats the stable rail at 1280. On /library/takeover/ at 1280 the rail still measures x0 w240 but elementFromPoint(60,400) returns P.muted: the page is painted over it. There is no exit link, no crumb, no close - a scan of every visible leaf for exit/back/close/x found nothing. Browser Back is the only way out. At 3440 the rail survives, so it is a width bug, not a design choice.

CONFUSING - three vocabularies for six blocks. The rail says THE SIX BLOCKS: Stage, Navigation, Content, Room, Arrangement, Skin. The toolbar's controls are navigation, arrangement, content, room, type size, plus two colour rows - Stage has no control and Skin is not named. /library/nest/ ends with 'The five words are the building blocks'. The page.json that Build writes uses a third set: style, content, mech, kids, layout, arrange. And navigation and arrangement share three option words - both offer Left rail and Right rail.

CONFUSING - the best control is hidden and the worst one is on the front. The drawer (More) is chips with a label and a one-sentence explanation under each group - the clearest control in the realm. The hover toolbar, which is what a newcomer meets, is five native selects 80-111px wide that clip their own values (Top tabs reads 'Top tab', Reading is cut), unlabelled colour dots, and a bare unstyled SPAN for More. Same six words, two different control languages, the weaker one first.

CONFUSING - the hub's main wall is text, not previews. 'Twelve pages, ready made' is twelve one-line description cards. The owner asked for previews that link to demos; /templates/ delivers exactly that (eleven real running pages, seven-up, using the whole 3440) and is still the best page in the realm - the hub does not copy it.

SPACE - the hub's first screen is still half empty at 3440. The stage measures x503 w1152, right edge 1655, so 1785px (52%) of the row beside it is bare grey above the fold. The v3 landing's '2.6% dead' is the widest painted element over the whole scrolling pane (the twelve-card wall), not the first screen the owner sees. At 1280 the same stage fills the column and the page reads well - the hub is worse on the bigger screen. The rail's own content is 2205px against a 1440 viewport, so MAKE & BUILD, NEXT DOOR and Back to Imagine sit below its fold at 3440.

FIXED, credit where due - reload really resets (set content to dashboard, reloaded, back to docs, localStorage empty); the rail really never moves (x0 w240 across three navigations, one visible page each time, no two-columns-at-once); a whole dashboard really runs nested inside an article on /library/nest/; the two colour rows really are independent; and the owner's 981px-button complaint is gone - /toolbars/right/ now draws four ~135px chips.

SIX WORDS, 1-5. simple 3 - one rail, one stage, one drawer is a simple shape, but the same six ideas carry three different name sets and one page says five. powerful 4 - live configuration, real nesting, and Build writes a real page.json. organized 4 - seven labelled rail sections put every page one click away and nothing jumps; critique/ and inventory/ still serve 200 with nothing linking to them. intuitive 2 - the headline gesture covers the thing it is demonstrating. easy to browse 3 - browsing never jumps, but the main wall is text and four block pages open with visible asterisks. infinite potential 2 - every control is a closed list (6 navigations, 7 arrangements, 8 contents, 4 rooms, 3 sizes, 5+5 colours) and nothing lets a reader add a value.

assign.outcome:
**Second visit, cold, 1280 and 3440. The realm is far better organized and four things are genuinely fixed — but the front door's headline gesture is broken.**

![the toolbar sitting on top of the demo's own tabs](shots/toolbar-covers-tabs-3440.png)

**The six words, 1–5.** simple **3** · powerful **4** · organized **4** · intuitive **2** · easy to browse **3** · infinite potential **2**.

**Four things are broken, proven not described.**
1. **You cannot click the demo's tabs.** The hover toolbar is drawn at y274–369 and the tab strip at y310–353, so pointing at the page puts the toolbar over it — `elementFromPoint` on all four tab centres returns `DIV.paging-toolbar`, and a click times out at 30s. [/imagine/paging/stage/](/imagine/paging/stage/) opens by saying *"Click the tabs on the page below"*.
2. **The hub contradicts itself.** Force-clicking Pricing shows the caption **THE BOX DID NOT MOVE — ONLY THIS DID** with the line beneath it reading *"The box is 335px shorter"*. ([picture](shots/box-did-not-move-335px-3440.png))
3. **Literal `**asterisks**` above the fold** on four of the six block pages — [skin](/imagine/paging/skin/), [content](/imagine/paging/content/), [room](/imagine/paging/room/), [arrangement](/imagine/paging/arrangement/). ([picture](shots/skin-raw-asterisks-3440.png))
4. **The takeover preset paints over the stable rail at 1280** and offers no way out but browser Back. ([picture](shots/takeover-hides-rail-1280.png))

**Still confusing.** Three vocabularies for six blocks — the rail's six names, the toolbar's seven controls (Stage has none, Skin is not named), and the `page.json` Build writes (`style` `content` `mech` `kids` `layout` `arrange`); `/library/nest/` says *"the five words"*. `navigation` and `arrangement` both offer **Left rail** and **Right rail**. The drawer's chips-with-a-sentence are the clearest control in the realm and they are hidden behind **More**, while the front shows five clipped native selects.

**What the owner asked for and still isn't there.** Previews that link to demos — the hub's main wall, *Twelve pages, ready made*, is twelve text cards; only [Templates](/imagine/paging/templates/) does it right ([picture](shots/templates-the-good-one-3440.png)). And the hub's first screen is **52% bare grey** at 3440 (stage x503 w1152 of 3440); the v3 landing's 2.6% measured the whole scrolling pane, not the fold.

**Fixed, credit where due.** A reload really resets · the rail really never moves · one click really opens one page · a dashboard really runs nested inside an article · the two colour rows are independent · the 981px-button complaint is gone.
